newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares end thin bourse off record highs.
newsitem.headline: German shares end thin bourse off record highs.

text.p: 1141 GMT - German shares end bourse trade off their session highs, buoyed by the firmer dollar, steady Bunds, modest gains on Wall Street. But dealers say market may be overbought at these levels and warn of danger of a correction. Attention likely on U.S. durable goods data due 1230 GMT.
* 30-share DAX index ends up 7.58 points at 2,666.55 , off high of 2,672.59, upside potential seen limited.
* December DTB DAX futures up 5.5 at 2,684.0.
* Mannesmann up on French telecoms alliance news.
* Schering gains on higher 1996 dividend forecast.
